templates.label: Inventory steering
templates.description: Inventory steering dashboard built from weekly sales by product family: coverage, service level, forecast accuracy and weeks below safety stock. With a Stock column the real stock is used; otherwise stock and replenishments are simulated from sales.

templates.label: Sales tracking
templates.description: Sales tracking dashboard built from sales lines: revenue and change against the same period last year, monthly curve, product families, customers and regions. Data is aggregated by month.

templates.label: Sales forecast
templates.description: Weekly sales forecast dashboard by product family: total forecast over the horizon, change versus the same period last year, reliability of the method on past data, peak week and breakdown by family. Forecast from the th2forecast engine, falling back on a naive forecast.

templates.label: Deliveries / OTIF
templates.description: Customer delivery tracking from one row per order line: delivered on time, delivered in full and OTIF (both), average delay, open late lines and quantity fill rate, by customer, carrier and product family.

templates.label: Production quality
templates.description: Production quality tracking from one row per batch or per shift: reject rate, first-pass yield, volumes, reject causes (Pareto) and, with the planned time, run time and ideal rate, the OEE (availability, performance, quality).

templates.label: Customer receivables aging
templates.description: Customer receivables tracking from one row per invoice: total and overdue outstanding, overdue share, DSO, breakdown by aging band (not due, 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past due), most overdue customers and monthly billing. Lateness is measured at the last invoice date of the file (not today's date). DSO is the outstanding amount divided by the billing of the last 90 days, multiplied by 90. The open amount comes from the Open amount column, otherwise from the Paid amount, otherwise from the Payment date; with none of the three, all invoices are considered open.

templates.label: Purchasing and suppliers
templates.description: Purchasing tracking from one row per purchase order or purchase invoice line: total spend and spend by month, number of suppliers, dependence on the top five suppliers, spend by supplier and by item. With the quantity, the average price per item; with the promised and received dates, the on-time delivery rate and the average delay.

templates.label: Support and SLA
templates.description: Support tracking from one row per ticket: tickets received, open backlog, median first response time, share of tickets within SLA, tickets per week and per priority, and a table per team. A ticket is within SLA if its first response and its resolution meet the objectives in hours (configurable); an open ticket whose objective is already exceeded counts as outside SLA, the reference date being the most recent one in the file. Without a resolution date, there is no backlog.

templates.label: Financial management

params.label: Variable share of consumed purchases, accounts 60 (%)
Variable share of external services, accounts 61-62 (%)
Variable share of payroll costs, accounts 64 (%)

templates.description: Monthly financial dashboard built on a FEC (French accounting entries file): cash, revenue, gross margin, approximate EBITDA, payroll costs, break-even point and approximate working capital requirement, with the waterfall from revenue to net result and the main expenses by account.

templates.label: Cash forecast
templates.description: Cash forecast from one row per period (week or month, and per account if needed) with the balance, cash in and cash out: balance projected over the horizon in three scenarios (pessimistic, central, optimistic), minimum cash threshold, first period below the threshold and weeks of cash on hand. Flows are predicted by the forecast engine.

templates.label: HR / Absenteeism and payroll
templates.description: HR dashboard for a small business from one row per employee and month (Silae, PayFit or Excel payroll export): absenteeism rate, turnover, headcount, payroll and its trend, average cost per employee, hires and exits, absence reasons and breakdown by department.

templates.label: B2B services / Utilization and billing
templates.description: Management of a services business (consulting, engineering, agency) from one row per consultant and per day or week (time-tracking export): utilization rate, billable rate, average day rate, revenue per consultant, left to invoice, top customers and utilization by consultant.

templates.label: Online store
templates.description: Online store dashboard built from one row per order (Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop export): revenue, orders, average order value, contribution margin, ROAS with an alert below a threshold, customer acquisition cost and share of repeat customers. Cancelled or refunded orders are excluded. Ad spend can appear on dedicated rows of the same file.

templates.label: Restaurant
templates.description: Restaurant management from one row per day (or per service): food cost and labor cost as % of revenue, prime cost with adjustable targets, average check, covers and revenue by day of the week.

templates.label: Construction sites

params.label: Cost drift threshold (% of cost budget)

templates.description: Construction site profitability tracking from one progress statement per site and per month (cumulative amounts): estimated margin at completion against budgeted margin, cost drift, gap between billing and progress (overbilled or billing late) and sites drifting beyond an adjustable threshold.
